metadata.llm_reason: Maximum TF Normalization is a distinct micro-skill with a specific normalization technique (dividing by max TF with smoothing parameter) that differs fundamentally from TF-IDF weighting in peer_candidates. While both operate in term_weighting task_family, this skill addresses document-length bias through intra-document normalization, whereas TF-IDF uses collection-level statistics. The skill has direct support evidence and fills a legitimate gap in normalization strategies.
